fields.statement: Verified at 8eb70a774 (attempt 2). Read the diff of 4ddef2aa9 and 8eb70a774: runRunStart reserves a number only when newMilestone (milestone plan with no request milestone, or a plan on a record change set), drawing it under a lock as one more than the highest landed milestone field and every run journal's MilestoneNumber (ended and failed included), and journals it in Started.MilestoneNumber, which run status shows as milestone_number. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(plan-milestone-number|describe-golden)$': PASS. plan-milestone-number starts new-milestone plan runs with run start against landed milestones 12 and 35 and sees 36 then 37, a failed run holding 38 so the next gets 39, run status --json showing milestone_number, and a milestone request naming milestone-35 started with no milestone_number. Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run TestFoldMilestoneNumber (failed run folds 36, no number folds 0 and omits the field): PASS. Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run Milestone: all 17 tests PASS, including TestReserveMilestoneNumber and TestLaunchEnvMilestoneNumber. That run then hit the enclosing-root state-folder guard. Rerunning the leaf's api tests alone passed cleanly, so the guard failure does not come from this change. Attempt 1's three findings (no run-start test, no existing-milestone test, no internal/run test) are each addressed.
